title: MARTA: A Decoupled Multi-Agent Architecture for Python Test Generation
description:
Artifact for the ICTSS 2026 paper MARTA: A Decoupled Multi-Agent Architecture for Python Test Generation.

MARTA is a Python regression test generation pipeline that separates abstract test planning from concrete test implementation. A Planner Agent designs logical test scenarios from a statically derived semantic context; an Assertion Agent translates each plan into a complete Pytest file. An execution-driven repair loop and a coverage-guided planning loop refine the result.

This archive contains the MARTA implementation, the measurement pipeline, the SLURM job scripts used to run the evaluation, the patch series applied to the single-prompt baseline, and the complete results: every generated test suite as delivered, the per-project token counts and phase timings, and the candidates MARTA discarded.

The evaluation covers 27 open-source Python projects (486 modules) from the benchmark introduced by Pynguin and subsequently used by CodaMosa and CoverUp, with DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite (16B) served locally, plus a ten-project subset with Qwen2.5-Coder-32B.
